dialogues.speaker: Cowardly Night Raven
dialogues.text: D—Don't hurt me! A—And don't come any closer, either!

dialogues.speaker: Cowardly Night Raven
dialogues.text: Y—You're not a monster or a knave, you say? Wh—Who'd believe that? I'm n—never opening this door!

dialogues.speaker: Cowardly Night Raven
dialogues.text: Didn't I say so already? I—I won't open this door! Begone!
